text:
release-bot: Packaging job kicked off for private build v3.2.1-delta. Payload: detached manifest + delta tarballs. Target handoff window: 17:00-19:00 PT. @marta can you confirm signer cert and S3 ACLs?

marta: looking now. quick question — are we using sha256 or blake2 for the detached manifest checksums for this run?

samir: +1 on checksum question. Also what's our canary subset for Private? Last time we used 3 sites.

jia: we have three vpc customers agreed for canary: acme-prod (low traffic), beta-ops (staging), and infra-sandbox. Plan was rolling-staged, not all-at-once.

lucas: rollback plan reminder: if the manifest fails signature verification or any image mismatch in first 4 canary hosts, automatic abort and publish rollback marker. Need clear criteria.

marta: using sha256 for tarballs, manifest file uses blake2b-256 (aligns with the offline transport validation). I just noticed signer cert expires 2026-03-22 — that's tomorrow. We should not rely on primary cert for unattended handoff.

release-bot: deploy-bot scheduled handoff to private-us-west at 18:30 PT if all checks pass. Will attach manifest and signatures to the courier bundle.

ops-bot: preflight checks passing: checksum validation ok (local), image digests match pinned list, ingress ACLs for escort host validated.

marta: plan: generate a one-off ephemeral signing key from HSM, cosign it with the expiring cert, include cosign chain in the bundle. Steps:
```bash
# create ephemeral key in HSM and export public handle
hsmctl generate-key --label=ephemeral-deploy-2026-03-20 --out=ephemeral.pub
# sign manifest with ephemeral via cosign using key reference
cosign sign --key hsm://ephemeral-deploy-2026-03-20 detached-manifest.json
# publish signature next to manifest
aws s3 cp detached-manifest.json s3://private-handoff/3.2.1/detached-manifest.json --acl bucket-owner-full-control
aws s3 cp detached-manifest.json.sig s3://private-handoff/3.2.1/detached-manifest.json.sig --acl bucket-owner-full-control
```

samir: sounds good. Two operational asks: 1) add a verifier step in the escort script that checks both the cosign chain and expiry window; 2) record the ephemeral key handle in release notes.

jia: can we get a tiny test run against infra-sandbox at 17:45 PT (non-blocking) to validate the escort unpack + verify flow? That will be our gating test before the 18:30 wider handoff.

lucas: yes do the test. If test fails, we stop wider handoff and follow rollback playbook: publish rollback-marker.json with reason, revert manifest pointer to v3.2.0, notify customers via ticket template.

release-bot: noted. Adding gating check: escort-test -> signature_verify -> image_digest_check -> unpack_success. If any fail -> stop and alert #incidents.

marta: I've uploaded the ephemeral public handle metadata to s3://private-handoff/3.2.1/ephemeral-meta.json and staged the cosign sigs in the bundle. Upload log: upload: detached-manifest.json -> s3://private-handoff/3.2.1/ (ETag: "9f1b...")

deploy-bot: quick FYI: automated canary roll schedule set to 18:35 PT, 3 hosts concurrently, 5min probe window each. If 2/3 probes fail -> abort cascade and trigger rollback marker.

ops-bot: escort script snippet (will run on carrier host):
```bash
# verification step
cosign verify-blob --key ephemeral.pub detached-manifest.json.sig detached-manifest.json || exit 1
sha256sum -c detached-manifest.json.sha256 || exit 2
# unpack
tar -xzf delta-package.tar.gz -C /opt/redwood/install || exit 3
```

marta: doing the 17:45 infra-sandbox run now, posting logs in thread.

marta: infra-sandbox test: signature verification ✅, digest check ✅, unpack ✅, service start (local smoke) ✅. Latencies OK.

jia: thanks. proceeding to allow 18:30 wider handoff. Please update release notes with ephemeral key handle and expiry workaround.

samir: adding rollback criteria to release notes summary: 1) cosign verification failure 2) image digest mismatch 3) >33% host failure in first 15min 4) critical errors during post-install smoke tests.

lucas: I'll prepare the rollback marker generator script and ticket template.

marta: final upload: detached-manifest.json.sig and ephemeral-meta.json set to public-handoff location. Confirmed ACLs, checksums, and cosign chain included.

release-bot: handoff started to private-us-west at 18:31 PT. Notifying escorts.

deploy-bot: canary 1/3 succeeded, canary 2/3 succeeded, canary 3/3 in progress.

deploy-bot: canary 3/3 succeeded. Rolling to remaining cassette hosts with gradual 10-min waves.

ops-bot: monitoring dashboards: error rates normal, token-store latencies within SLOs.

marta: closing thread — artifacts uploaded, ephemeral key recorded, release notes updated with checksum and rollback criteria. Will follow up with postmortem if any customer-impact. :thumbsup:
